source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the start of the dihybrid cross (PDF 86).

blocks.text: Yeh dikhane ke baad ke aik khasiyat ke alleles alag hote hain, Mendel ne dekha ke kya mukhtalif khasiyaton ke genes bhi azadana (independently) alag hote hain. Us ne do khasiyatein ikatthi dekhin: beej ki shakal, jis mein gol (R) dominant aur jhurridar (r) recessive, aur beej ka rang, jis mein peela (Y) dominant aur hara (y) recessive.

items: Dono dominant khasiyaton wale khalis nasl paude: gol aur peele beej (RRYY).
Dono recessive khasiyaton wale khalis nasl paude: jhurridar aur hare beej (rryy).

blocks.text: Us ne yeh khalis nasl paude milaye (RRYY x rryy). Sab F1 beejon mein dono dominant khasiyatein, gol aur peela, theen aur woh heterozygous the, genotype RrYy. Aise F1 paudon ko dihybrids kehte hain kyunke woh dono genes ke liye heterozygous hain.

blocks.prompt: RrYy paude ko dihybrid kyun kehte hain?
blocks.explanation: Kyunke woh aik saath do genes ke liye heterozygous hai: beej ki shakal (Rr) aur beej ka rang (Yy).

items: Mendel ne beej ki shakal (R/r) aur rang (Y/y) ikatthe dekhe.
RRYY x rryy se sab gol peele RrYy dihybrids ka F1.
